title: EuroBirdPortal – Live bird movements across Europe
summary: EuroBirdPortal is a web-based platform that provides real-time visualization of bird migration patterns and movements across Europe, aggregating observational data from citizen science networks and ornithological databases.
problem_solved: It solves the problem of fragmented and inaccessible bird observation data by creating a unified real-time visualization platform for tracking bird migrations across Europe.
why_valuable: It democratizes access to bird migration data for researchers, conservationists, and enthusiasts, supporting biodiversity research and citizen science initiatives across the continent.
